model: Single SegFormer-B0 local head:0.6 deployed v11 parameter state +0.4 fine-tuned v17 parameter state. Frozen terrain parameters identical. No ensemble at runtime.
selection: Fixed BILINEAR CPU validation objective, subject to retaining all17 baseline-found large object instances on consumed v8 training controls. Weight grid0,.05,.1,.15,.2,.25,.3,.4,.5; selected0.4 before v9 predictions. Paired probability ensemble rejected at548.9MiB CPU peak.

promotion_gate.large_object_retention: Every baseline-found reviewed component >=2500 native pixels retains >=25% coverage; apparent size is a diagnostic only, not a physical obstacle criterion.

annotation: Same native source hashes, manually reviewed polygons, six-pixel uncertain collar and explicit255. New test images never used to select a weight or train an encoder.
preprocessing: Exactly the production512 BILINEAR resize and mean/std normalization; initial experimental bicubic calibration was discarded before selection.
